source.title: A quadratic interaction estimate for conservation laws: motivations, techniques and open problems

trace.notes: Original source https://zbmath.org/6675433 was blocked_or_challenged by Cloudflare on direct fetch. The official zbMATH REST API resolved document 6675433 to DOI 10.1007/s00574-016-0171-9 and the title used in source metadata.

Identifier-specific recovery checked the Springer DOI landing page and fulltext endpoint. The visible HTML exposed the abstract, references, metadata, and a PDF iframe, but not the full article body containing the open problems.

The Springer PDF endpoint was reachable and a PDF was downloaded to .sisyphus/paper-question-parser/tmp/6675433.pdf, but local PDF text extraction could not run because the sandbox returned: bwrap: loopback: Failed RTM_NEWADDR: Operation not permitted. No accepted question can be produced without page-located verbatim problem evidence.

Crossref provided only metadata and TDM links for the same DOI. OpenAlex confirmed the work is closed access with no best open-access location and no repository full text. Exact-title searches surfaced metadata pages, the Springer page, author publication listings, ResearchGate snippets, and related but different works; these were rejected as metadata, snippets, or non-identical sources.
Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source with extractable, page-located problem statements in the available execution environment.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/6675433.json and outputs/latest.json.
